product.name: Rockstar_ibot
product.usage: Use as the product name in every public product and fundraising field.
product.one_liner: A proactive general agent that manages your body, mind, and money, follows through in the real world, and coordinates verified essentials support through human-approved, vendor-direct provision rather than recipient cash payouts.
product.mission: End suffering for humans and, ultimately, all living beings by making dependable care, agency, and verified access to essentials continuously available.
product.vision: Rockstar_ibot grows from managing one human life across physical health, mental wellbeing, finances, work, and schedules into a general manager and essentials-distribution network for every living being.

application_answers.short_description: Proactive general agent for your whole life
application_answers.problem: A person's health, mental wellbeing, money, schedules, work, and access to basic necessities are fragmented across tools and organizations. Advice and cash-only promises do not guarantee that the needed food, shelter, care, communication, or transport actually arrives.
application_answers.solution: Rockstar_ibot coordinates specialist organs, acts within delegated boundaries, verifies outcomes with receipts, and adds an essentials-only support workflow: a human or partner verifies recipient consent and need, a verified vendor receives the order, and purchase, dispatch, and receipt are tracked separately.
application_answers.why_building: Kai is building one dependable manager that does not stop at advice and can carry real goals through disconnected systems. The long-term mission is to reduce suffering by making agency and verified access to necessities continuously available without handing recipients cash or cash-like instruments.
application_answers.progress: The local runtime, owner-only Hub, Kai-owned private GitHub repository, public avocadomini site, Kai-owned @avocadominibot Webhook and command profile, Supabase durable job queue, Railway Core, Mac Codex bridge, multiple specialist loops, essentials-only request policy and planner, and a purpose-gated vendor bank-request builder exist. Real-user Telegram-to-Codex message receipts, bot-token rotation, automatic GitHub deployment credentials, Kai-owned live bank credentials, procurement vendors, delivery providers, billing, and receipt-backed revenue are not yet verified.
application_answers.market: The initial users are founders and professionals whose lives and work span many disconnected systems. The broader market is anyone who needs trusted execution across health, work, and finances; do not invent a numeric TAM without current sourced evidence.
application_answers.business_model: A free self-hosted option can drive trust and adoption. An always-on hosted Rockstar_ibot may become a paid monthly subscription after Kai-owned billing and delivery are verified. Any support funding is restricted to approved vendor procurement and is not paid to recipients.
application_answers.differentiation: Rockstar_ibot is a manager rather than a chat assistant or dashboard: it takes authorized action, coordinates specialized agents, preserves provenance, and distinguishes attempts from provider-verified completion.
application_answers.how_built: One general-agent harness uses models for semantic judgment and unfamiliar interfaces, while deterministic code owns permissions, money arithmetic, state transitions, deduplication, receipts, and scheduling.
application_answers.use_of_funds: Improve reliable agent execution, expand secure integrations, build privacy-protected needs intake, connect verified procurement and delivery partners, strengthen receipt-backed verification, and deliver the always-on cloud product to early users.
